title: Config Rationale Guard
job: Keep configuration decisions and exceptions visible, valid, and reviewable as strict JSON, YAML, and TOML files evolve.
smallest_useful_product: An offline CLI that pairs strict configuration with adjacent rationale annotations, validates schema and annotation targets, and renders a PR diff of changed decisions.
success_measure: 90% of policy-sensitive setting changes carry a linked rationale and stale rationales are detected in CI.
constraints: Never include config values in reports
Schema behavior is explicit per format
